column2: the plan moves `python/test_lint_bg_wait_coverage.py` to `python/tests/lint/test_lint_bg_wait_coverage.py` and updates makefile harness paths, but `python/larch/implement/checks_run_relevant.py` still keys the bg-wait direct-target rule on the deleted flat path. after the move, edits confined to the relocated pytest module no longer match that tuple, so `python3 python/cli.py checks run-relevant` during `/implement` can skip `test-lint-bg-wait-coverage` (and related hook guard targets) even though ci/`make py-test` still pass. that regresses focused local verification and conflicts with scope item 4 ("no behavior change").

after mirroring `test_lint_tier1a.py` under `python/tests/lint/`, keeping `path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]` resolves to `python/tests` instead of the repo root. at the flat path `parents[1]` was correct; from the nested path the repo root is `parents[3]`. a naive parent-index update breaks `test_live_repo_files_pass` or points `lint_tier1a.check_root` at the wrong tree.
